extension.description: Otak Monitor shows real-time CPU, memory, and disk usage in the VS Code status bar with detailed tooltips and Markdown clipboard snapshots.
command.copyMetrics.title: Copy System Metrics
command.cycleStatusBarView.title: Switch Status Bar Reading
config.cpu.showRunningClock: Show the clock the processor is actually running at rather than its nominal clock. Available on Windows and Linux.
config.cpu.showTemperature: Show the CPU temperature when the machine exposes a readable sensor. The row and the status bar reading are hidden where it does not.
config.folderSize.enabled: Measure the size of the open folder. Turning this off stops the directory walk entirely, which is worth doing where an on-access virus scanner makes it expensive.
config.folderSize.excludeNames: Directory names to leave out of the folder size, wherever they appear in the tree — for example `node_modules` or `.git`. Excluded directories are never walked.
